title: Bound on the Nontrivial Operator Norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A$ be a symmetric real $n\times n$ matrix with nonnegative entries and every row summing to $1$. Let $\lambda(A)$ be the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors $v$ orthogonal to the constant vector with every coordinate $1/n$. Then $\lambda(A)\leq 1$.
